<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This creates unnecessary confusion and diverts attention from the actual root cause.\n\n## Who is affected\n- At least 2 accounts have reported this issue via support channels [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].\n- One of the affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has an ARR of £1,600,000 and is due for renewal on 2026-12-12 [i:12562525e3b8565d].\n- The other affected account, Ormsgill Cyber, has an ARR of £135,000 [i:64074f6fe85adcfb].\n\n## Evidence\n- There have been 2 total mentions of this problem [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].\n- All 2 mentions came through a single route: support [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].\n- A user from Marrowgate Commercial stated, \"I’ve ruled out our own systems — it’s definitely a customer network failure, not Keelwater being down, though the error message makes it sound like a bug.\" [i:12562525e3b8565d].\n- A user from Ormsgill Cyber stated, \"That’s what I suspected — our IT team is looking into the customer network failure now. Sorry for the false alarm.\" [i:64074f6fe85adcfb].\n- The total ARR from accounts that have mentioned this issue is £1,735,000 [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].\n- In the last 90 days, 1 of the affected accounts has renewed [i:12562525e3b8565d].\n\n## Why now\nThis issue is actively causing confusion and wasted effort for at least two customers, as evidenced by their recent support interactions in September and October 2026 [i:12562525e3b8565d][i:64074f6fe85adcfb].
